repo_url.description: Optional in mod.json; the registry supplies the source repository URL.

mod_dependencies.description: Required pak mods, validated against package_db.

plugin_dependencies.description: Required DLL plugins, validated against dll_db. The launcher requires explicit enablement and Unchained launch.

dependencies.description: Legacy spelling of mod_dependencies. Both lists are combined on read, deduplicating repository/version pairs. Use mod_dependencies in new metadata.
